patterns.note: The hero section uses an asymmetrical layout with a large, abstract 3D graphic occupying the right side and the primary headline and call-to-action on the left.

The navigation bar transforms from a transparent background with light text to a solid white background with dark text and a slightly reduced height as the user scrolls down the page, remaining sticky at the top.
The large, abstract wavy graphic in the hero section exhibits a subtle parallax effect, moving slower than the foreground content as the user scrolls, creating a sense of depth.
A consistent palette of deep dark blue, crisp white, and soft light blue gradients is used to define sections and brand elements, creating a professional and clean aesthetic.
Content sections are clearly delineated by alternating background colors (white, light blue gradient, dark blue) and generous vertical spacing, enhancing readability and visual hierarchy.

technique_notes: A sticky header is implemented that dynamically changes its background color, text color, and height once the user scrolls past the initial hero section, providing a clear visual cue of its active state.

The hero section incorporates a large, abstract 3D graphic that is positioned to move at a slower rate than the page's main content during scrolling, creating a subtle parallax effect that adds depth and visual interest.
Content is structured into distinct, well-padded sections, often employing a two-column grid for presenting features or detailed information, with clear, bold headings and concise supporting text.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, bold, modern sans-serif headings (~3-4x body text) with generous line height, complemented by smaller, lighter body text and very small uppercase labels for categories.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounded corners (e.g., 4-8px) on buttons and input fields, contributing to a soft yet professional feel.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced and airy, with ample vertical padding between major sections and clear internal spacing within content blocks, contributing to an uncluttered and premium appearance.

standout: The site's standout feature is the distinctive, flowing 3D abstract graphic in the hero section, which subtly parallaxes as the user scrolls. This dynamic element immediately conveys a sense of sophisticated movement and financial flow, elevating the design beyond a generic corporate template.
